stages.headline: Площадь осевого сечения равна 48, h = 6. Найди r.

stages.headlineEnglish: The base area is 9π. Find r.
stages.problemText: The base area is 9π. Find r.

stages.headlineEnglish: An equilateral cylinder has r = 3. Find the axial section area.
stages.problemText: An equilateral cylinder has r = 3. Find the axial section area.

stages.headline: Осевое сечение цилиндра — квадрат со стороной 4. Найди его диагональ.
stages.headlineEnglish: The axial section is a square of side 4. Find its diagonal.
stages.problemText: The axial section is a square of side 4. Find its diagonal.
